description: This file defines a configuration class for integrating Sagemaker's chat API within a larger LLM framework. It includes methods for URL construction, request signing, and streaming response handling specific to Sagemaker's `/invocations` API endpoint, especially focusing on stream handling for chat models.

classes.name: SagemakerChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interacting with Sagemaker's chat API, extending OpenAIGPTConfig and BaseAWSLLM, providing methods for environment validation, URL generation, request signing, and streaming responses.
